_source: Shared reference-led creator builder, revised after the October 2026 output audit. Prompt requests guide generation; they do not establish content acceptance.

slots.identity: the person chosen in the approved brief
slots.imperfections: ordinary texture; distinctive marks only when explicitly chosen
slots.framing: camera height, visible body area, headroom and action space
slots.scene: the actual approved setting and background
slots.focus: reference-led natural, deep or shallow focus

negative_prompt: waxy skin, beauty filter, airbrushing, plastic gloss, exaggerated pore craters, sharpening halos, artificial grain overlay, doll proportions, malformed hands, extra fingers, dead glassy eyes, cropped face, invented text, logos, watermarks, nude, bare shoulders, topless
